training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of gear cutting setup, safety checks, and cutter selection; Instructor supervision during setup verification
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a milling machine?
Name two types of gear cutters used in milling.
What safety precaution is essential before starting a milling machine?

topics: Cutting speed and feed rate calculation
development.content:
Selection of appropriate gear cutter
Workpiece mounting and alignment
Machine setup and parameter selection
Cutting speed and feed rate calculation
Initial roughing cuts execution

Finishing cuts and dimensional accuracy
Deburring and surface inspection
Measurement using vernier calipers
Identification of common cutting errors
Proper tool handling and storage

Final quality assessment criteria
Documentation of work performed
Machine shutdown and cleaning procedures
Review of safety protocols observed
Preparation for next operation sequence

summary_questions: Explain the importance of correct cutter selection in gear cutting.
Describe the steps taken to ensure dimensional accuracy during finishing cuts.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between gear cutting in a milling machine versus a shaping machine, referencing LP 02.
